verdict.rationale: Brex lets admins define spend, documentation and approval rules that run automatically on transaction events. Brex AI applies these rules to every transaction, auto-blocks out-of-policy purchases, routes multi-level approvals by amount, vendor or role, and its review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses and escalates exceptions. These are first-party rule-to-action automations, but they are limited to preset spend-control actions. Webhooks and the Zapier, Workato and Pipedream integrations are building blocks or third-party tools, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined trigger/condition/action rule builder, configurable actions beyond block/approve/route, technical docs on rule configuration (all evidence is marketing pages), independent or hands-on corroboration.
